title: Migrate Encounter resource to add CareTeam reference field
description:
Add a CareTeam reference field to the Aidbox Encounter resource. Update the FHIR profile, adjust search parameter indexing, and migrate existing Encounter records. This change affects all tenants.

## MoC

| # | AC | MoC | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | CareTeam field present on new Encounter records | integ | Aidbox API call verifies field |
| 2 | Existing Encounter records migrated without data loss | integ | migration script + audit log |
acceptance_criteria:
- New Encounter records include a CareTeam reference field
- Existing Encounter records are migrated with zero data loss
- Search by CareTeam reference returns correct results

metadata.intent: Support care team attribution on Encounter resources. Scope IN: Aidbox profile update, migration script, search index. Scope OUT: UI changes, reporting.
metadata.constraints: Must run migration in off-peak hours.
